DRAFT - Solicitation 36C24927Q0014, Amendment 0003
ATTACHMENT 1
LIMITATIONS ON SUBCONTRACTING PERFORMANCE APPROACH
Solicitation 36C24927Q0014 - Amendment 0003
This attachment is incorporated into and made a part of RFQ 36C24927Q0014 by Amendment 0003.
1. Purpose
Each quoter shall submit a concise narrative explaining its anticipated approach to performing the requirement and complying with VAAR 852.219-75, VA Notice of Limitations on Subcontracting - Certificate of Compliance for Services and Construction. The Government will use the narrative to evaluate the quoter's understanding and the reasonableness of its proposed technical approach.
2. Applicable Limitation
This acquisition is for services, except construction. The contractor shall not pay more than 50 percent of the amount paid by the Government to firms that are not certified SDVOSBs or certified VOSBs, subject to the terms, exclusions, and treatment of similarly situated entities stated in VAAR 852.219-75 and 13 CFR 125.6.
3. Required Submission
Submit a document titled 'Limitations on Subcontracting Performance Approach.' The narrative should be sufficiently detailed to permit evaluation but should not include proprietary information beyond what is necessary to explain the proposed approach. A recommended length is five pages, excluding the signed VAAR certification and supporting tables.
At a minimum, address the following:
Element
Required Information
Performance approach
Identify the principal work elements, the work the prime expects to perform, and the work it expects to subcontract.
Anticipated subcontracting
Identify anticipated subcontractors, if known; describe their expected work; and provide estimated dollar values or percentages. Identify whether each subcontractor is expected to qualify as a similarly situated entity.
Compliance calculation
Provide a reasonable illustrative calculation showing the anticipated amount paid by the Government, amounts expected to be paid to non-certified firms, amounts attributed to similarly situated entities, and any proposed exclusions permitted by the governing requirements.
Monitoring and controls
Describe how the contractor will monitor invoices, payments, lower-tier subcontracting, certification status, and changes affecting compliance during each period of performance.
Corrective action
Describe how potential noncompliance will be identified, elevated, corrected, documented, and reported to the Contracting Officer when required.
Consistency
Ensure the narrative is consistent with the technical and price quotation, including the proposed labor, equipment, vehicles, facilities, and subcontracting approach.
4. Separate Mandatory Certification
The quoter shall also complete, sign, and submit the certification contained in VAAR 852.219-75(d). The performance-approach narrative does not substitute for the clause certification. The Government will not consider a quotation for award if the required certification is not submitted, as stated in VAAR 852.219-75(d).
5. Evaluation
Under the Technical factor, the Government will evaluate whether the submission demonstrates an understanding of the limitations on subcontracting and presents a reasonable, internally consistent approach to maintaining compliance during performance. The Government may consider the relationship among the performance approach, proposed subcontracting, price quotation, resources, and other technical information.
The performance approach is not a substitute for an SBA status determination and will not be used to impose a requirement more restrictive than VAAR 852.219-75, 13 CFR 125.6, or other applicable law. A deficient narrative may lower the Government's assessment of the quotation under the Technical factor. The mandatory effect of failing to submit the signed VAAR 852.219-75(d) certification remains governed by the clause.
6. Post-Award Compliance
The contractor remains responsible for actual compliance throughout performance. Consistent with VAAR 852.219-75(b) and (c), the Contracting Officer may request records needed to assess compliance, including invoices, subcontracts, payment records, lower-tier information, and calculations. Any performance approach incorporated into the award will supplement, but will not supersede, the clause or applicable law.
7. Revised Addendum to FAR 52.212-1
Add the following to the quotation submission requirements: 'Limitations on Subcontracting Performance Approach required by Amendment 0003, together with the separately completed and signed VAAR 852.219-75(d) Certificate of Compliance.'
8. Revised Section E.2 Technical Factor
Add the following technical evaluation element: 'The Government will evaluate the quoter's understanding of and reasonable approach to complying with VAAR 852.219-75, including the relationship between work performed by the prime, work subcontracted to similarly situated entities, work subcontracted to other firms, monitoring controls, and consistency with the technical and price quotation.'
 
ADDENDUM to FAR 52.212-1 INSTRUCTIONS TO OFFERORS COMMERCIAL PRODUCTS AND COMMERCIAL SERVICES
The Offeror shall submit their quote on company letterhead and include the Price/Cost Schedule provided with the Statement of Work. Quoter shall include unit price, total, unit quantity and item description as specified above, proposed delivery time, name, address, and telephone number of the quoter, firm s SAM Unique Entity ID (UEI) and ORCA document in SAM at www.sam.gov, terms of any express warranty, unit price, overall total price.  All prospective offerors must include appropriate references which must include all applicable company information.  In addition, the quote shall include a separate narrative to specifically communicate the quoter s technical ability to meet the performance requirements and complete and sign VAAR 852.219-75, Limitations of Subcontracting and VHA and Local Business Associate Agreement (BAA).
